name: Run-Length Encoder
description: GPU run-length encoding stage. Lossless; effective when data contains long runs of identical values (e.g. quantized codes after a predictor). Wire format: [num_runs:u32][values:T×n (4B-aligned)][lengths:u32×n]. Worst-case output is ~2× input + 4 bytes (no repeated values). Byte-transparent output.
